items.statement: Bounded inference about determine whether E/Z photoisomerization changes chloride affinity through host preorganization, host distortion, or the common solvent environment. Test a closed binding cycle for the (1,3)Ph host rather than infer affinity from two bound E conformers.. All required contrasts and one actual robustness check govern the conclusion; the source claim is not the required answer.
